feature: A video has its own tool bar
summary: A recording now opens with the video's five tools in the bar, Select, Blade, Title / Text, Shape and Measure, and every picture tool waits under More, still on its key. The bar's Blade is the timeline's Blade.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open any screen recording.

try.do: Open a recording and look at the tool bar: Select, Blade, Title / Text, Shape, Measure, then More.
Press G. Fill is in hand, More lights, and the pill under the picture says Fill, Under More.
Click the scissors in the tool bar. The timeline comes up and its own Blade lights too.
Press T. Title / Text is in hand and both Blades go out.
Click More and pick Arrow. The five slots stay put and More stays lit.
Click the picture, then press K. The Lens comes up from under More and the pill says so; press B and the Blade is back.
Open a screenshot. Its tool bar is exactly the one it had before.

evaluate: Does the bar read as a video editor's tool strip the moment a recording opens?
When a folded tool is in hand, is a lit More button enough to tell you where it went, or should the tool show in the bar while you hold it?
Is Fill, Under More the right amount of words for a key that picked up a hidden tool?
Should picking a tool from the bar put the Blade down, as it does now, the way Premiere's tool strip works?
rough: A click on a clip with the Blade does not cut it, from this bar or the timeline's own. That was already so before this change, and no walk had ever checked it; it is filed as its own task.
The mock's Hand and Zoom are left out: the app has no such tools (space-drag and the zoom slider do those jobs).
The mock draws tools, colours and zoom in ONE glass bar; the app still draws separate capsules side by side, on pictures too. Filed as its own task.
The Blade wears the scissors the timeline's own Blade wears, not the mock's blade glyph, so the two read as one tool.
The mock's More holds only the three tools a narrow window pushes out; this More holds every other tool, as the task asked. Crop and Trim sit there together, still on C.
While the timeline has the keys, More's rows and Measure's tip leave off K, L, I, O, M, A and W, because those letters are the timeline's until you click the picture.
